title: NANSEN saved views
description: Named views of one entity type's table, at views/<entityType>.views.nansen.json in the project: which rows (a list of keys, as dev's extra metatables held, and/or filters on columns) and which columns to show. The dashboard applies them; the table itself is not changed.

name.description: Unique within the entity type; also what the dashboard shows.

keys.description: When given, the view holds only these entities (and of them, those the filters keep).

filters.description: Every filter must hold for a row to be shown.

values.description: op in: the row's value is one of these (null for none).

min.description: op range: at least this (a number, or a date or datetime as in the CSV).

text.description: op contains: text the value contains, ignoring case.
